title: Approximate Transitivity of Young Translation on Rough Paths
summary: We show that Young translation has dense orbits in the space of rough paths: for any two geometric rough paths, one can translate the first by a sequence of smooth paths so that it converges to the second in rough path topology. As applications, we obtain full-support criteria for rough paths arising from random series and Gaussian processes, including non-centered fractional Brownian rough paths.
